description: Validation requirements — schema and structural validation rules. Sourced from input_schema.json, output_schema.json, and review_taxonomy.yaml (COMP, CWE, RET).

entries.title: Finding must have all 5 required sections: Observation, Exploitation, Recommendation, Re-Test Verification, Metadata
entries.description: A complete VAPT finding (per EVVO report standard, see DOC-000001 DETAILED FINDINGS) must contain all five sections: (1) Observation — what was found and how it manifests; (2) Exploitation — concrete reproduction steps, commands, request/response pairs, or screenshots; (3) Recommendation — actionable remediation steps addressing root cause; (4) Re-Test Verification Result — status of retesting after fix (Verified/Fixed/Not Retested); (5) Metadata table — Severity, Affected Targets, CWE-ID, Impact, Retest Status, Affected User Roles, CVSS Score+Vector. Missing any of these sections prevents reliable review. Findings missing Observation, Exploitation, or Recommendation are blocked; missing Re-Test or Metadata are flagged as needs_revision.
conditions: retest.verification_result is null or 'Re-Test Verification Result:' line is empty
metadata table missing any of: Severity, Affected Targets, CWE-ID, Impact, CVSS
entries.action: Flag as incomplete (taxonomy COMP). Report specific missing sections. If Observation/Exploitation/Recommendation missing: set review_status=needs_revision and block. If only Re-Test or Metadata missing: flag as needs_revision but allow pipeline to continue.

entries.title: CVSS vector must be valid and score must match
entries.description: The CVSS vector string must be parseable according to the declared CVSS version (3.1 supported in v1). The reported score should match the vector calculation. Malformed vectors are flagged for manual correction.
conditions: CVSS score does not match vector calculation
entries.action: Flag as CVSS validation issue (taxonomy CVSS). Do NOT recalculate score. Flag requires_manual_recalculation as true. Human must correct.

entries.title: CWE ID must follow CWE-NNN format
entries.description: The CWE identifier must follow the format CWE-NNN where NNN is a positive integer. Non-standard formats (e.g., 'CWE123', 'CWE-ABC') are invalid. The CWE should also be relevant to the finding title.
conditions: CWE ID does not match CWE-NNN format
CWE does not match vulnerability category
entries.action: Flag as invalid or mismatched CWE (taxonomy CWE). Do not auto-correct. Human must assign correct CWE.

entries.title: Finding must pass data governance checks before review
entries.description: Before a finding can be reviewed, it must pass governance checks: usage_approved must be true, usage_scope must be internal or evaluation_only, and redaction_status must indicate redaction has been applied or is not applicable.
entries.action: Block review. Return human_review with governance violation reason. Do not proceed with review pipeline on governance-failed findings.

entries.title: Retest status must be valid if applicable
entries.description: If retest is applicable (retest.applicable is true), the retest status must be a valid enum value and evidence should be provided for any non-not_retested status. Findings marked as remediated without retest evidence are flagged.
conditions: retest indicates fixed but no retest evidence
entries.action: Flag as retest validation issue (taxonomy RET). Do not auto-fill retest status. Human must schedule retest or provide results.

entries.title: Input must match schema version 0.2
entries.description: The input finding must declare schema_version '0.2' to be processed by the current harness. Other versions are rejected at the validation step.
entries.action: Reject input. Return error with expected version. Cannot proceed with review.
